title: nail beds
body:
every once in a while
after i clumsily slam my finger into
a wall or pinch it in a door, i find myself
looking into my nails under
my astral incandescent bedside lamp.
i find myself gazing into the clouds baked
into my keratin, watching
their glacial march to the edge of the world.
wishing to see them dance as they do when
i watch timelapses of the troposphere.
each night eagerly awaiting the moment
when they hang seconds away from being
icebergs. for the satisfaction
of carving a new blue sky.

but after so many blue skies, i miss the little
flying sheep that showed me who i was. just
a mumbling bumbling stumbling boy
who misses the days when you would clip
the clouds from my fingertips.
